tileEnv.SH_FIXTURE_DESC: Oric Atmos (1984) at its own untouched power-on screen: "ORIC EXTENDED BASIC V1.1 / (c) 1983 TANGERINE / 37631 BYTES FREE / Ready" in black on a white page, with the machine's own CAPS marker in the top-right corner, drawn fullscreen with aspect correction by MAME 0.289's `orica` driver on an 800x600 X root — 4:3, the shape the Atmos drew on a television, and measured 1.6x cheaper to blit than 1024x768 on this box. Nothing is curated and nothing is typed. Keyboard-only exhibit; no pointer device; AY-3-8912 sound -> ALSA -> AC97. The interaction is the registry demoProgram, a colour-and-sound listing in Oric Extended BASIC that the SPA types and the visitor runs.

museum.notes: Live streamhost tile. Emulator-in-captured-Linux BRIDGE tile: a captured Debian 12 kiosk runs MAME's `orica` driver emulating an Oric Atmos; streamhost captures the Linux framebuffer + AC97 audio exactly like every other tile. The emulator is a pinned MAME 0.289 built for oric.cpp only in the Bookworm chroot (scripts/build-guests/emulators/build-mame-oricatmos.sh) — the lab host's packaged 0.276 is trixie-ABI and Bookworm's own is 0.251. One 16 KB preservation-source ROM (basic11b.rom, Extended BASIC V1.1) is staged outside the repo and gated by asking the shipped binary's own -listxml which sha1 it demands for bios ver11. Drawn fullscreen with aspect correction on an 800x600 X root, which is 4:3 — the shape the machine drew on a television, and the mode that measured 1.6x cheaper to blit than 1024x768 on this box. The golden is the machine's own untouched power-on screen; the interaction is the registry demoProgram. Keyboard-only exhibit; beige-tower-crt fallback archetype. See streamhost/docs/BRIDGE.md and docs/guests/oricatmos.md.

reset.fixture: Oric Atmos power-on screen (ORIC EXTENDED BASIC V1.1, (c) 1983 TANGERINE, 37631 BYTES FREE, Ready) under MAME 0.289 `orica -bios ver11`, fullscreen with aspect correction on an 800x600 X root; golden INTERNAL snapshot restores the untouched cold boot. Nothing is curated into the fixture and no post-restore keys are sent. Keyboard proof runs AFTER the bake against the restored fixture — PRINT 6502*7 echoes and is answered — so nothing typed can reach the golden. Keyboard-only exhibit (no mouse); AC97 audio.
